title: [3.3.x. Beta] Client 1 + 2, COB displayd negaitve after neg. Carb Correction, Broadcasting to Client 1 for Dual Wear display won't work after that
symptom: After entering negative carbs, COB was displayed negative on the graph. Later, Client 2 stopped broadcasting to Client 1, so no data from Client 2 appeared in the dual watch face. A full database reset did not fix it, but reinstalling Client 2 restored broadcasting.
fix: The issue is fixed in dev and will be part of the next beta.
evidence_quote: this is fixed in dev and will be part of next beta
